verdict.rationale: RevenueCat manages subscriptions and offers its own web billing (RevenueCat Billing), so card-lifecycle dunning features are a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence pack never mentions a network account updater, backup payment methods, or hosted update-payment pages. The webhooks, paywalls and web SDK evidence covers other capabilities and does not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As an ops user, expiring or replaced cards update themselves — network account updater, backup payment methods, and hosted update-payment pages
